proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H hA hH hperp
  have core : ∃ x : ℝ, H = AffineMap.lineMap B C x ∧ dist A H ^ 2 = x * (1 - x) * dist B C ^ 2 ∧
      dist A B ^ 2 = x * dist B C ^ 2 ∧ dist A C ^ 2 = (1 - x) * dist B C ^ 2 ∧
      dist B H = |x| * dist B C ∧ dist H C = |1 - x| * dist B C := by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hH
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hdBC : dist B C = ‖C -ᵥ B‖ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B]
    rw [hdBC]
    set d : V := C -ᵥ B with hd
    set h : V := A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x with hh
    have hBH : B -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (-x) • d := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
    have hCH : C -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (1 - x) • d := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, ← hd, sub_smul, one_smul]
    have hin : inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
      rw [InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two]; exact hA
    have e1 : B -ᵥ A = (-x) • d - h := by rw [← hBH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
    have e2 : C -ᵥ A = (1 - x) • d - h := by rw [← hCH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
    have hdh : inner ℝ d h = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hperp
    rw [e1, e2] at hin
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hperp, hdh,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hin
    have key : ‖h‖ ^ 2 = x * (1 - x) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by linear_combination hin
    have a1 : dist A B ^ 2 = x * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, e1, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left, hdh, norm_smul, key,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
      ring
    have a2 : dist A C ^ 2 = (1 - x) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, e2, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_left, hdh, norm_smul, key,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, a1, a2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A, ← hh, key]
    · rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V B, hBH, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
    · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C, hCH, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  obtain ⟨x, -, -, h1, -, h2, -⟩ := core
  rw [h1, h2]
  by_cases h0 : dist B C = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · have hp : 0 < dist B C ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hx : 0 ≤ x := by
      by_contra hn
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist A B), not_le.mp hn]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H : P), EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 2 → H ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → dist A B ^ 2 = dist B H * dist B C
